g.text: Bridgewater makes timely retrieval a learning loop
An early-October question about AI and currencies exposes a July source in a generic answer.
Problem: a relevant-looking July source may be stale for an October research question.

g.text: The speaker corrects recall to precision. No held-out design or uncertainty is supplied.
Retrieval relevance does not establish final-answer correctness, investment performance or alpha.
Agents gather broadly; people inspect concise evidence. A demo’s source count is not a quality benchmark.
